RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: WITH ServicePlans AS ( SELECT licenses.skuPartNumber, licenses.skuId, json_each.value AS service_plan FROM licenses, json_each(licenses.servicePlans_json) ), ParsedServicePlans AS ( SELECT skuPartNumber, skuId, json_extract(service_plan, '$.servicePlanId') AS servicePlanId, json_extract(service_plan, '$.servicePlanName') AS servicePlanName, json_extract(service_plan, '$.appliesTo') AS appliesTo FROM ServicePlans ) SELECT skuPartNumber as licenseName, skuId, servicePlanId as planid, servicePlanName as planName FROM ParsedServicePlans WHERE appliesTo = 'User' and ( '$$licenseFilter$$' like '%licenseFilter%' or skuPartNumber like '%$$licenseFilter$$%');

ParameterInfo.Name: licenseFilter
ParameterInfo.DisplayName: Only return licenses that contain this text. Leave blank for all licenses
